observations.content: Production outage on 2025-03-15 caused by a failed database migration on the auth-service. Root cause: migration-runner applied schema changes out of order.
The outage lasted 4 hours. Rollback was manual because migration-runner v3.1 did not support automatic rollback.
Post-mortem identified that database-migration-risk was underestimated. No pre-migration validation was in place.
Database migrations have a 60% failure rate in this environment due to lack of staging parity.
Pattern: every incident involving migration-runner has cascaded into auth-service degradation.
Risk mitigation: migration-runner should run in dry-run mode first, but this is rarely followed.
migration-runner v3.2 introduced a silent data corruption bug when applying ALTER TABLE on partitioned tables.
migration-runner v3.2 was deployed to production 2 days ago without the standard validation checks.
migration-runner connects to auth-service's primary database via direct connection string.
The data corruption bug in migration-runner v3.2 may have already affected auth-service tables.
auth-service was rebuilt last week using migration-runner v3.2 to apply schema changes.
auth-service depends on migration-runner for all schema updates. Last migration ran 2025-03-28.
auth-service user table may have data integrity issues related to the migration-runner v3.2 corruption bug.
Potential data integrity issue detected in auth-service but not yet investigated. Dreamer flagged this as high-surprise.
If the migration-runner v3.2 corruption bug affected auth-service, user sessions and credentials may be compromised.
This risk is connected to the outage-2025-03-15 pattern: migration failures cascade into auth-service.
CI/CD pipeline uses GitHub Actions with a 15-minute timeout per job.
Pipeline includes lint, test, build, and deploy stages.
Deployments are triggered by merges to main branch.
Blue-green deployment strategy is used for all services.
Dashboard is a React SPA served from CDN.
Dashboard fetches data from the analytics API, not auth-service.
Shared component library using Storybook for documentation.
Components follow atomic design principles.
Platform team owns auth-service, migration-runner, and deploy-automation.
Team has 5 engineers, on-call rotation is weekly.
Frontend team owns dashboard and component library.
Team uses a 2-week sprint cycle.
Engineering org has 3 teams: platform, frontend, and data.
CTO reviews architecture decisions quarterly.
